mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 7.5% indicates deteriorating labor market conditions that signal economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 7.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) are increasing while retail sales (RSAFS) are decreasing, it indicates a weakening consumer demand for durable goods relative to housing, which signals an economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition (HOUST rising and RSAFS falling) occurs in more than 60% of cases where SPX 60-day returns are positive.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply-constrained economy (INDPRO level below 100), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate profitability from supply bottlenecks.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below 100.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a robust labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS exceeds 135,000.

mechanism_narrative: A CPI inflation rate exceeding 2.5% signals persistent inflationary pressures that prompt the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) is below 100 and housing starts (HOUST) are above 900, it indicates a weak manufacturing sector and a strong housing market, which signals an economic imbalance and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition (INDPRO < 100 and HOUST > 900) occurs in more than 60% of cases where SPX 20-day returns are positive.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (RSAFS level above 450,000), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to overvaluation and profit-taking.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS exceeds 450,000.
